description:
Janet Carroll Estate Agents proudly welcomes you to 97 Rowanbyrn, a charming four-bedroom detached family home, ideally positioned in one of South County Dublin's most sought-after residential locations.

Set within a peaceful, leafy cul-de-sac of detached homes, this much-loved property has been in the same family's ownership since 1976 and has been well cared for throughout the years. Extending to approximately 91.6 sq. m. (986 sq. ft.), it offers an exciting opportunity to create a wonderful long-term family home, with excellent potential for further extension, subject to the necessary planning permissions.

Rowanbyrn enjoys a superb residential setting in the heart of Blackrock, an established and highly regarded location renowned for its quality of life. Quiet and mature, yet exceptionally well connected, it offers the best of both worlds — peaceful surroundings alongside an outstanding choice of amenities close by. Blackrock DART station, local bus services and the QBC are all within easy reach, providing convenient access to Dublin city centre and the surrounding area, while the N11 Quality Bus Corridor and the M50 are also readily accessible. UCD Belfield and Trinity College are easily reached, with a direct bus connection also available to DCU.

The location suits an active lifestyle too, with a superb range of sporting and recreational facilities nearby, including tennis, rugby, football, swimming, running routes, cinemas, the library and lawn bowls.

The property is particularly well suited to family life, occupying a quiet position within a cul-de-sac of detached homes that provides additional parking, while a nearby green play area offers a wonderful space for children to enjoy.

Blackrock and the surrounding area are renowned for their outstanding selection of educational facilities. Nearby schools include Carysfort National School, All Saints Church of Ireland, Blackrock College, St Andrew's International School, Newpark Comprehensive School, Oatlands College and UCD Michael Smurfit Graduate Business School, while an Educate Together Secondary School is also under construction nearby, further enhancing the area's appeal to families.
